cause: Q1'24 record bookings (3,800+ deals, 3,100+ customers) beat plan, AFFO/share beat and FY24 AFFO growth guidance raised to 10-13%, churn lower than forecast, xScale hyperscaler pre-leasing accelerated (+48MW since last call), interconnection pricing spread ~16% between churned and new
quality: 经营性持续: bookings/pricing strength and hyperscaler/AI demand ($1.3B+ annualized hyperscaler revenue) are structural, though management itself called AI opportunity 'quite early days' - an honest, credible caveat rather than hype
reason: Genuine beat-and-raise from a mature, profitable REIT with positive mark-to-market pricing and record bookings, not a speculative story. High capex ($2.8-3.0B guided) is normal for this REIT's growth-funding model (xScale build-out), not an anomalous surge, and AFFO growth was raised alongside it. Only real blemish is a disclosed SEC/DOJ subpoena the company is cooperating with, plus modest 1% YoY cabinet count growth showing density/land constraints in some markets - neither changes the quarter's substance.
red_flags: 已披露收到SEC/DOJ传票,调查结果和时间线不确定;部分核心市场(纽约/新加坡/都柏林/加拿大)产能受限;机柜数量同比仅增1%(密度提升抵消)
